primary_question: Can a full-terrain learned representation with explicitTX-surface-RX geometry improve generalization beyond currentpointfeatures and coarse attention?
inputs: Raw publishedH andTX;same45 input-only maps for controlledA/B (C17first45 channels:basic31+phase14), excludingC10predictionchannels, masks and labels. Preserve absoluteH andfinegeometry; inputaudit required before implementation.
target: Directly predict dual-band excess pathloss overFSPL. No frozenC10prediction in forward; no hard calibration to the unvalidatedC20point-power field.
architecture: Shared terrain encoder with full-resolution local detail features and multiscale global terrain tokens.
RX queries attend to terrain tokens; frequency-conditioned queries permit different terrain contributions for each band.
Explicit learned relative-geometry attention bias fromTX-to-surface andsurface-to-RX distances,directions andheight relations. These are input-derived descriptors,not measuredpaths.
Continuous dB outputs withband-specific nonlinear readouts; shared geometry does not impose sharedfinepowertextures.

controlled_comparison.anchor: FrozenC10 performance on identicalcompleteDEV predictions; not a matched architecture control because feature organization differs.
controlled_comparison.A: Same new backbone, local detail branch andfrequency-conditioned readouts; content attention without explicitrelative-geometrybias.
controlled_comparison.B: A plus relative-geometrybias;sameinputinformation,trainingpoints,maporder,optimizer,numberofupdates andcheckpoint rule;report parameter andFLOPdifferences.
controlled_comparison.attribution: BvsA tests targeted geometry interaction. AvsC10 orBvsC10 tests complete systems; do not attribute the whole difference toattention.
controlled_comparison.later_controls: Only after credible gain, testfine-resolutionbranch andfrequency-conditioning individually. Do not bundle extra loss terms andsampling changes in initialA/B.

optimization_protocol: Before large runs, a small fixedFIT subset checks whether both models can fit observedmaps; success only checksoptimization/capacity,not generalization or physicaltruth.
Main paired comparison uses the existingterrain-disjointFIT/DEV partition. C17smallpilot is not a substitute forcoverage ofallFITterrains.
Freezecommontrainingconfig andevaluation before comparisons. Report actual optimizersteps,samplesseen,learning-rate trajectory,exactfixedFIT andDEVmetrics.
Use valid-pixel dualMSE initially. Evaluate the officialformula (mean ofper-bandpooledmaskedRMSE) and eachband separately; no gradient/spectral auxiliaryloss in the firstcomparison.
Uniform sampling initially. Any latergeometry-stratifiedsampling requires importanceweights andaseparatecontrol.
Selection usesDEV only; officialVAL is reserved for a frozen promotedcandidate. HistoricalDEV use must be disclosed.

Failure is classified:implementation/optimizationfailure,capacity/inputrepresentationlimitation,overfit/generalizationfailure,orvalidnegativearchitecturecomparison; never infer inputirreducibility from onefailednetwork.
resources: CC only; exactGPU3 UUID GPU-9a72820b-a8c2-0a94-2297-4f65afc67eb0 for futureGPUwork; retain recent0.15per-processmemorycap,stream batches instead ofall-dataGPUcaching; profile before fixingbatchsize; no job launched.
promotion: Require material andconfirmedimprovement inbothbands againstC10,not just lowerFITerror orvisuallysharpoutputs. Smallgains are not1dBsuccess. Actualbudget andacceptance thresholds must be frozen before execution,not chosenafterresults.
interpretation: Attentionweights are latent computationalweights,not a recoveredPAS/PDP or proof ofactualmultipath.
